stem: Select TWO actions that support this requirement: AWS cost management tools with appropriate use cases (for example, AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, AWS Cost and Usage Report)

choices.text: Store AWS access keys in the workbook git repo
Skip teardown if the instance is stopped
Use root credentials for every lab step
Design against the stated requirement and document tradeoffs
Validate with official documentation before applying

rationale: A and B are sound exam/lab practice. C/D/E violate credential, teardown, or root-user rules.
